sourceText: B-e62e DONE transcript showed that story_advance captured milestone-closeout.json but the automatically appended Milestone Status table recomputed live archived state and falsely showed stale or blocked rows. Fix DONE milestone_status to read the frozen closeout snapshot while preserving active live projection.
normalizedOutcome: DONE stories with milestone-closeout.json show a stable Milestone Status table with completed rows, no false stale evidence, and no false blocked current/remaining rows.
acceptanceClaim: A regression proves lattice milestone_status --storyId=<DONE-story> reads milestone-closeout.json and renders Completed rows from the frozen snapshot while active stories still use live projection.
